imagens.prompt: Landscape 16:10. A small table on a Lisbon apartment balcony at golden hour: an open laptop with a blank softly glowing screen, a ceramic cup of coffee, a closed plain leather notebook with a completely blank cover. Wrought iron railing, azulejo-tiled facade across the narrow street, terracotta rooftops and the Tagus river in soft haze beyond.
Landscape 16:9. An older couple seen from behind, walking arm in arm along a Lisbon miradouro at late afternoon, looking out over terracotta rooftops and the river. Calm, unhurried, warm side light.
